scope: Whole private native process, including prepared-file cloning/open, warmups, measured repetitions and close. No import. No delayed initialization or signal filtering; sample all threads from process startup. Not query-only CPU and never formal latency.
reason: Delayed-initialization CPU reports contain only about 0.06s CPU for a multi-second active window; do not treat those fractions as complete-query evidence. Compare captured CPU with isolated child user/system usage.
